name: Kamurai Jin
source: Captain of Frostheim House and heir to the influential Kamurai family. Though surly and arrogant, he is highly capable. Once the charismatic ruler of Frostheim, lately he spends his days locked away in his icy chambers, and few can even claim to have seen his face.
